ModMetaData.name: Faster Game Loading - Continued
ModMetaData.author: 綠菇
ModMetaData.description: Does loading take forever? This mod is for you! Sick of staring at the loading screen every time you start RimWorld? This mod shortens startup by doing work in parallel, in idle gaps and from cache. The bigger your mod list, the more you save. Gameplay and saves are not affected. All options are in Options > Mod options > Faster Game Loading - Continued. Most players can keep the defaults. Loading options take effect the next time the game starts. Loading (enabled by default) - Load mod content early: Loads textures, sounds and other mod content during idle gaps while RimWorld is still parsing XML, instead of waiting for each mod's turn. It starts only after every mod has initialized, so other mods' patches still apply, and stops once loading has finished. - Multi-threaded preloading: Parses each mod's XML on up to 8 CPU threads instead of RimWorld's 2 worker threads per mod, keeping the original override order. RimWorld 1.7 already parallelizes this itself, so the XML gain there is only about 10%. A background thread also reads texture files ahead of time (at most 256 MB at once), so the main thread does not wait on disk reads. With Hyperdrive, Defs XML is left to Hyperdrive. Texture read-ahead is skipped when Graphics Settings+ or Image Opt loads textures, and on RimWorld 1.7, which reads textures ahead itself. - Type lookup cache: Indexes every type name once at startup and remembers names resolved in the previous session, so RimWorld does not have to search every assembly for each name. The cache refreshes automatically when the mod list or any assembly changes. Graphics and atlases - Delay graphic and icon loading (disabled by default, requires restart): Moves non-essential graphics and icons to after the main menu appears; they are processed while the main menu is shown, without waiting for a save. Essential categories such as furniture still load first. On RimWorld 1.7, deferred texture uploads finish before the menu even when startup atlas baking is skipped; RimWorld's own atlas baking, compression, disk caching and source-texture eviction run after the queued graphics and icons. The menu can appear sooner, but the deferred work can cause a long frame afterward and increase memory use. If another mod rewrites a graphic after it was queued (for example Bionic Icons), it is built normally but kept out of the static atlas, as in vanilla, which also avoids atlas mask conflicts. Advanced option: if you see missing or late textures, turn this off first. - Adaptive atlas baking (disabled by default, RimWorld 1.6 only, requires restart): Only works together with Delay graphic and icon loading. Bakes the deferred static atlases on the main menu, several per frame within a 50 ms frame budget, in batches sized to your GPU's speed (at least 1024x1024 pixels' worth). One large atlas can still take a long frame. Without delayed loading, RimWorld's own baking is used. - Trim static atlases (enabled by default): RimWorld rounds each static atlas up to a power-of-two height, which often leaves half of it empty. This bakes each atlas only as tall as its textures need, so atlases use less memory and bake faster when RimWorld has to build them from scratch (RimWorld 1.7 loads already-built atlases from its own disk cache on later runs). Every texture keeps its pixel position. - Skip duplicate atlas textures (enabled by default): RimWorld bakes a minifiable building's texture into the Building, Item and Misc atlases. The Item and Misc copies are skipped and the Building copy is shared, unless their mask states conflict. - Faster atlas compression (disabled by default, RimWorld 1.6 only): Compresses baked atlases on the CPU in Unity's standard mode instead of its high-quality mode, which adds dithering and takes longer. GPU compression is unchanged. Diagnostics - Verbose logging (disabled by default): Writes debug messages to the log. If it is on when the game starts, one "Startup timing" line also reports how long after the main menu appeared the deferred visuals and all deferred work finished. Texture tools (manual) - Downscale textures: Creates smaller copies of high-resolution textures in a separate cache, used from the next startup. Target sizes: Building, Pawn and Tree 256px; Apparel, Weapon, Item and Plant 128px; Terrain 1024px. Original mod files are never modified. Hidden while Graphics Settings+ or Image Opt loads textures; converting to DDS with those tools is faster and gives better quality, so use this only when you cannot use them. - Clear texture cache: Removes the downscaled copies, so original textures are used on the next startup. Always on - Sound definitions finish resolving after the main menu appears. A sound that plays earlier, such as a menu click, is resolved on the spot, so the main menu is not silent. Things to know - The game may briefly show "not responding" during startup. This is normal while the mod works in the background. - Works well with Loading Progress, Graphics Settings+, Hyperdrive, and Missile Girl - Performance Mod or DefLoadCache (choose one). - Image Opt compatibility is no longer maintained. Use Image Opt fork (Steam Workshop id 3781013698) instead and load it after this mod. Original mod by Taranchuk. This is a maintained fork with bug fixes and improvements.
